capabilities: offer card, titled link, or plain URL when pasting or dropping a link
convert a URL, link, or card between the three styles later
refresh a card's metadata from the linked page
convert Auto Card Link blocks into the plugin's card format
skip or force a paste style per domain via settings lists
extras: The marketplace description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Cards are plain fenced code blocks that stay readable without the plugin, and page metadata comes from <title>, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, which some sites withhold from non-browser requests.
problem: Pasting a URL into Obsidian gives no choice of format; turning it into a titled link or a preview card requires fetching metadata and editing by hand.
summary: URL paste helper that lets you choose a preview card, a titled Markdown link, or the plain URL when pasting or dropping a link.
